## The question

[How does latexmk find the file it should compile?](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/12883/how-does-latexmk-find-the-file-it-should-compile), asked by user3992 on TeX Stack Exchange (2011-03-07; [CC BY-SA 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/)):

> Following up on https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/12729/gedit-missing-link-texlive
>
> ```latex
> latexmk myfile.tex
> ```
>
> delivers this answer:
>
>
> ```latex
> Latexmk: Could not find file [myfile.tex]
>
> Run number 1 of latex [myfile.tex]
>
> This is pdfTexk, Version 3.141592-1.40.3 (Web2C 7.5.6) 
>
>  %&-line parsing enabled.
>
> entering extended mode
>
> ! I can't find file 'myfile.tex'
>
> <*> myfile.tex   
>
> Please type another input file name:
> ```
>
>
> I renamed the file but still it could not be found.
>
> does a `.tex` file have to be in a specific place in order to be found by `latexmk`?
:::

Make sure you are running this command in the same directory as `myfile.tex`.
